scope: H6-NATIVE-ELECTRICAL-SEMANTICS family-evidenced terminal typing only: 34 exact Yageo RC0402/RC0603 resistor groups and 33 exact Murata GRM/GJM/GCM MLCC groups present in current H2, each checked for native pad inventory exactly1/2 and END_1/END_2 topology. This static allowlist does not include other two-pad devices, ferrite beads, resistor arrays, NFM/LL* capacitors or unknown families. Passive means a verified non-driven component termination, not unknown/unreviewed semantics. Native numbers1/2 identify the two nonpolar terminations; no manufacturer polarity/numbering assignment is claimed. Family evidence establishes only passive electrical type, not orderability, live availability, selected values, voltage/power/temperature ratings, RF suitability, DC bias, footprint dimensions, circuit correctness or production release approval. Candidate overlay only; production symbols are unchanged.
